apply_multidimensional_rope: apply multidimensional rotary positional embeddings to input arrays with configurable base frequency and scale factor
build_attention_module: build a multi-head attention module with RoPE, QK normalization, and optional clipped linear projections
create_feedforward_module: create a gated feed-forward module with GELU activation and configurable hidden dimension size
build_transformer_block: build a transformer block with pre and post normalization for attention and feed-forward sub-layers
review_attention_qkv_computation: review the attention module QKV computation with grouped query attention and softmax weighting
